prepared_writes.title: [o1-claude-jules-lane] claude_jules_live_adapter: git 'cannot lock ref' push rejection is misreported as an ambiguous outcome
prepared_writes.body:
`GitLiveClient._push` (automation/command_bus/claude_jules_live_adapter.py line 141) treats a push as a definite rejection only when the output matches `non-fast-forward|fetch first|stale info|already exists`. When two controllers push to the same branch at the same moment, git rejects the loser with `! <sha>:refs/heads/<branch> [remote rejected] (failed to update ref)` and `remote: error: cannot lock ref 'refs/heads/<branch>': is at <X> but expected <Y>`. That output does not match, so `_push` raises `RuntimeError(... outcome ambiguous ...)` instead of `PushRejected`, and `create()` cannot rebuild on the moved tip although git wrote nothing. Observed in the batch 27 two-clone race test; reproduced deterministically by feeding that exact output to `_push`.

Change only: automation/command_bus/claude_jules_live_adapter.py, automation/command_bus/tests/test_claude_jules_live_adapter.py. Do not weaken, skip or delete any existing test. Run the test commands before opening the pull request, and put `Fixes #<this issue>` in the pull request body.
